**Senior Technical Product Manager — On-Premise Solutions (Kiosk, POS & Self-Service)**  
  
***QSR & Restaurant Technology · Bilingual (Native Spanish / English) · LATAM · Client-Facing Product Owner***  
  
**Location: Remote – Must live in Mexico**  
  
**About Tillster**  
  
Tillster, headquartered in the USA, is the global leader in digital ordering and customer engagement solutions. For over a decade we have developed revolutionary self-service, ordering and payments solutions — for mobile, tablet, online, kiosk, call center, and more — creating personalized interactions based on consumer preferences, language, and currency. Our platform is compatible with 15+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi-unit restaurants. We offer one platform; one scalable, enterprise-class solution — to create world-class digital engagement solutions.  
  
Our mission and passion are one and the same: Empower restaurants and consumers to engage and transact anywhere, anytime, and from any device — one consumer at a time, one order at a time, billions of times over. In doing so, *together* we are transforming e-commerce in restaurants and making the till grow for Tillster and our customers.  
  
**About the Role**  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled, client-obsessed Technical Product Manager to join our dynamic and growing team. In this role you will act as the primary product owner and day-to-day technical point of contact for our customer(s), owning the relationship as well as the product. You will be responsible for the development and implementation of innovative on-premise solutions — including but not limited to self-service kiosks — that span both **hardware and software**, and you will serve as the trusted bridge between the customer, engineering, and design teams.  
  
You will hold responsibility for several of Tillster's key, high-profile clients across the **LATAM region**. This is a highly visible role with regular exposure to senior leadership — both internally and with our clients — so polished executive communication and sound judgment are essential.  
  
This role requires a deep understanding of on-premise and cloud restaurant technology — point of sale, payment, kiosk, and other on-premise systems — combined with the ability to read and work directly from **technical API documentation**, and the communication skills to translate complex technical detail into clear, professional, **client-facing documentation**. Because you will work closely with Spanish-speaking customers and stakeholders, this is a bilingual role: **native Spanish and professional working English are both required.**  
  
**Responsibilities**

* **Client Partnership & Product Ownership:** Serve as the primary product owner and day-to-day point of contact for the customer. Manage the client relationship end to end — setting expectations, aligning priorities, communicating trade-offs and timelines, and building trust as the go-to expert for their on-premise product portfolio. Lead client meetings, demos, and working sessions in Spanish and English.
* **Requirements Gathering & Prioritization:** Engage internal teams and both internal and global stakeholders to gather requirements and understand their needs and align with stakeholders on how success will be measured for each requirement. Translate these requirements into actionable product features and enhancements, aligning with leadership on prioritization and roadmap.
* **Hardware & Software Product Development:** Manage the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, across both hardware — such as self-service kiosks, digital menu boards, Kitchen Display Systems, cash payment machines — and software. Work closely with cross-functional teams including engineers, UI & UX designers, and customer representatives to define product requirements, create wireframes and workflow diagrams, and ensure timely delivery of on-premise solutions.
* **API & Technical Documentation Fluency:** Read, interpret, and work directly from technical API documentation to define integration requirements, validate feasibility, scope work with engineering, and answer customer technical questions. Comfortably navigate integration points across POS, payment, kiosk, and other on-premise systems.
* **Client-Facing Documentation:** Author and maintain high-quality client-facing documentation — feature definitions, configuration guides, release notes, RFP responses, and how-to materials — in both Spanish and English. Communicate the value of features without unnecessary technical jargon and select and articulate the best features to meet each customer's needs.
* **User Experience Optimization:** Continuously enhances the user experience of our on-premise solutions by gathering feedback from stakeholders and collaborating with UI/UX designers and engineers to implement improvements that drive customer satisfaction and maximize user engagement.
* **Technical Expertise:** Stay current with the latest advancements in on-premise hardware and software technologies and leverage your technical knowledge to define requirements that further enhance our product offerings.
* **Reporting:** Track and report on key success metrics for both product performance and the client relationship.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Native Spanish speaker (required),** with professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken) for cross-team and documentation work.
* **Strong client-facing product owner skills (required)** proven experience owning and managing an external customer relationship as the primary product point of contact.
* **Can break down complex technical projects into incremental value deliveries —** sequences work into clear, prioritized milestones that ship value early and often.
* **Prioritizes and drives alignment across the organization —** able to prioritize and gain alignment across competing dependencies and stakeholders throughout the organization, both internal and external, to keep delivery on track.
* **Demonstrated experience delivering on-premise hardware and software solutions,** including Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), digital menu boards, self-service kiosks, and cash payment machines — ideally in the Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) or hospitality industries.
* **Familiarity with agentic solutions —** experience defining or delivering AI agent-based capabilities that enhance ordering, customer service, or restaurant operations.
* **Understanding and knowledge of Point of Sale (POS) systems** — on-premise or cloud-based.
* **Defines and consumes APIs (required) —** able to define API specifications and to read and interpret technical API documentation to scope, validate, and communicate integration requirements, including documenting tool/product features and planning migrations between systems or platforms.
* **Proven ability to write clear, professional client-facing documentation — samples/portfolio required.** Shortlisted candidates will be asked to share 1–2 examples of documentation they authored (guides, feature definitions, release notes, or similar).
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
* **Senior-level Technical Product Manager (5+ years) —** proven experience in a similar role, preferably in restaurant technology, point of sale, payment systems, or on-premise / self-service technology.
* **Highly analytical and data-driven —** makes decisions from data, drives continuous improvement, and applies rigorous problem-solving with deep attention to detail.
* **Communicating clearly with all stakeholders —** keeps internal and external stakeholders aligned on project status, priorities, and trade-offs, and collaborates effectively across cross-functional teams and customers.
* **Familiarity with user experience design principles** and wireframing tools such as Figma.
* Ability to travel as business needs demand.

**Core skills & technologies:** Senior Technical Product Manager · Technical Product Owner · on-premise solutions · self-service kiosks · self-service ordering · digital ordering · POS / point of sale (on-premise and cloud) · payment systems · Kitchen Display Systems (KDS) · digital menu boards · cash payment machines · API specification and system integrations (REST) · agentic / AI solutions · QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) · hospitality and restaurant technology · product roadmap · stakeholder management · cross-functional leadership · data-driven product management · bilingual (native Spanish / English) · LATAM · Mexico.

**The Interview Process**

Recruiter interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

Technical interview with the VP of Product (may include a review of your documentation samples).

Final interview with our VP of Engineering, Kiosk.

**Making a Difference in the Tillster Way**  
  
Our mission is to empower restaurants and consumers globally, by empowering, supporting, and nurturing the people who are part of the global Tillster team. We want to ensure all employees feel respected, confident, and engaged. Creating an inclusive working environment is of the utmost importance to us. To make this a reality, Tillster is dedicated to embracing diversity in all forms and is proudly an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, family/parental status, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status.  
  
**Pay and Benefits (Mexico)**

* Compensation competitive to market and geographical location.
* Meal allowance for each day worked, available through a meal card.
* Home/Office allowance reimbursement per calendar month, pro-rated based on employment start date.
* **Health insurance:** Tillster pays the premium for employee private health insurance. Employees have the option to add their spouse/dependents at the employee's cost.
* **Holidays:** Up to 20 federal and local/municipal holidays in accordance with applicable Mexican Labour laws, dependent on your employment start date.
* **Vacation:** Up to 22 days of vacation every holiday year, pro-rated based on employment start date.
* **Education, Learning & Development:** We offer Udemy Learning courses and ongoing learning and development opportunities.

**Tillster is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer**  
  
**No Visa Sponsorship**  
  
**Principals only — no Agencies or calls please**

Revun is a complex operational platform requiring strong product judgment, workflow design, technical understanding, and the ability to translate real business operations into clear software requirements. About The Role Revun is hiring a Senior Technical Product Manager to own product requirements, roadmap priorities, workflow design, UX alignment, and product delivery. You will work directly with leadership to determine what should be built, why it should be built, how it should work, and what should be prioritized. You will work closely with the Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead, who owns technical architecture and engineering execution, while providing product direction to UX/UI, engineering, and QA. This is not a backlog administration role. We are looking for someone who can challenge unclear ideas, simplify complex workflows, make strong product decisions, and turn business requirements into clear development execution. What You Will Do Own the product roadmap, backlog, feature priorities, and product-side launch readiness. Translate business needs into clear requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets. Determine what should be built now, delayed, simplified, or removed. Map complex workflows across CRM, leasing, maintenance, payments, reporting, AI, integrations, and portals. Define product requirements across multiple user roles, permissions, dashboards, and workflows. Provide product direction to UX/UI and ensure designs reflect user needs, business rules, workflows, and edge cases. Work with the Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead on technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, estimates, and trade-offs. Coordinate with frontend, backend, AI/automation, integration, QA, and DevOps resources throughout development. Define requirements for AI-powered features and determinewhere AI, automation, or human review should be used. Work with QA on test scenarios, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and user acceptance testing. Review completed functionality and determine whether it meets the original product and business requirements. Identify product gaps, workflow conflicts, unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, dependencies, and launch blockers. Conduct product discovery and use stakeholder feedback, user needs, workflow analysis, and product data to guide decisions. Define measurable success criteria for major features and evaluate performance after release. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field. A technical degree is strongly preferred. 7+ years of product management, technical product management, or comparable product ownership experience. 4+ years working on complex SaaS, CRM, workflow automation, marketplace, fintech, PropTech, field-service, or multi-user operational platforms. Strong experience creating product requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and development-ready specifications. Experience taking complex features from initial business requirements through UX/UI, development, QA, release, and post-release evaluation. Strong working knowledge of APIs, integrations, databases, permissions, system dependencies, AI functionality, and modern SaaS platforms. Experience working closely with senior engineers, software architects, QA, and Product/UX/UI Designers. Experience with product discovery, user research, backlog management, prioritization, UAT, release planning, and launch readiness. Ability to challenge unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, unrealistic timelines, and weak product decisions. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Strongly Preferred Experience with PropTech, real estate technology, property management software, fintech, field service, compliance, marketplace, or operational SaaS platforms. Experience with AI/LLM workflows, AI automation, document processing, communications, task routing, reporting, or decision support. Experience with payments, payouts, reconciliation, accounting, ledger, or other financially sensitive workflows. Experience inheriting an existing SaaS platform and identifying product gaps, workflow problems, UX issues, and launch blockers. Experience preparing a complex SaaS product for commercial launch. Experience working with remote or offshore engineering teams. Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership. Ideal Candidate You are not simply someone who manages tickets or maintains a backlog. You Should Be Able To Determine What problem are we actually solving? Is this the right solution? Does the workflow make sense? What happens in the edge cases? Is this important enough to build now? Can it be simplified? How will we know whether it worked? You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and turning incomplete business ideas into clear product decisions that designers, architects, developers, and QA can execute. What Success Looks Like Within your first 90 days, you will understand the existing platform, clarify major workflows, improve product requirements and backlog quality, align UX and engineering priorities, identify launch-critical gaps, and establish a clear path toward commercial launch. Leadership should have clear visibility into what is being built, why it is being built, what is blocking progress, and what should happen next. Schedule Full-time, Monday to Friday, remote. Availability during core Eastern Time business hours is required. How To Apply Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

Position: UI/UX Designer  
Type: Full-Time  
Location: Hybrid (Bogota or Barranquilla)  
Employment Type: Full-time, Contractor

### **Who We Are**

SellCord is a leading agency specializing in launching and scaling brands exclusively on Walmart Marketplace. As Walmart-approved partners, we help businesses grow by optimizing their presence on the platform and driving sustainable success.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a creative, user-focused UI/UX Designer to join SellCord's Marketing team. This role designs the websites, landing pages, and digital experiences that turn Walmart Marketplace sellers into SellCord clients, and keeps our visual identity consistent across every touchpoint.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with a research-driven approach to user experience. They are comfortable owning projects from wireframe to developer handoff and thrive in a fast-moving, remote team.

### **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design and optimize SellCord's website, landing pages, and lead-generation flows with a focus on conversion.
* Create wireframes, user flows, and interactive prototypes in Figma for new pages and campaigns.
* Build and maintain a scalable design system and component library aligned with SellCord's brand.
* Conduct user research and usability testing, then translate insights into clear design improvements.
* Ensure all designs are responsive, mobile-first, and meet accessibility best practices.
* Prepare clean specs and assets for developer handoff, and support builds in Webflow or similar tools.
* Partner with marketing, sales, and leadership to design campaign assets, sales collateral, and event materials.
* Track page performance and iterate on designs based on data and stakeholder feedback.

### **Skills and Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience as a UI/UX, product, or web designer, ideally at an agency or B2B company.
* Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including auto-layout, components, and design systems.
* A strong portfolio showing web, landing-page, and conversion-focused design work.
* Experience with UX research methods, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.
* Strong English communication skills (verbal and written) are required.
* Familiarity with Webflow or other no-code builders and basic HTML/CSS preferred.
* Ability to take feedback well, iterate quickly, and explain design decisions in business terms.
* Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a remote setting.

### **Why It’s Awesome to Join SellCord**

* Be part of a fast-growing, innovation-driven company.
* Work with a global team committed to operational excellence.
* Competitive compensation package with vacation days, sick leave, and paid holidays.
* Opportunity to shape the look and experience of a growing brand from the ground up.

Este rol se enfocará principalmente en nuestros productos globales, como las experiencias de criptobilletera y tarjeta en Colombia y México. Es ideal para profesionales del diseño con una curiosidad innata, que se sienten cómodos asumiendo la responsabilidad de una función de principio a fin, atraídos por la resolución de problemas y disfruten colaborar con equipos de datos, cumplimiento e ingeniería. Traducir investigaciones, requisitos de producto y datos (por ejemplo, análisis de la tasa de abandono en el embudo) en flujos claros e interfaces de usuario de alta fidelidad. Diseñar dentro del sistema de diseño de MAJORITY y contribuir a él, creando componentes escalables, bien organizados y fáciles de expandir por otros diseñadores e ingenieros. Garantizar la calidad de los desarrollos de software con pruebas manuales y automatizadas, funcionales y no funcionales. Para esto, el cargo aplica prácticas internacionales de testing durante todo el ciclo de vida del software, prioriza las pruebas según el análisis de riesgos de calidad e implementa métricas para mejorar los procesos de forma continua. Responsabilidades Ejecutar pruebas manuales y automatizadas sobre los desarrollos de software, tanto funcionales como no funcionales (rendimiento, carga, APIs, entre otras). Aplicar prácticas internacionales de pruebas (ISTQB) en todo el ciclo de vida del software. Hacer análisis de riesgos de calidad y usarlos para priorizar las pruebas. Diseñar e implementar métricas de calidad, como cantidad de defectos, cobertura de pruebas y calidad de código. Mejorar de forma continua la automatización de pruebas en aplicaciones web, móviles, APIs y servicios. Documentar casos, evidencias y resultados de pruebas en las herramientas de gestión del equipo. Requisitos Certificación ISTQB (Deseable) Experiencia en pruebas manuales y automatizadas, funcionales y no funcionales. Manejo de herramientas de gestión: Jira (X-Ray) y Confluence. Manejo de versionamiento: Azure DevOps y Git. Conocimiento de bases de datos SQL, Oracle, DB2 y PostgreSQL. Dominio de Serenity BDD con patrón Screenplay y Gherkin/Cucumber. Experiencia en automatización de APIs con Karate. Experiencia en automatización móvil con Appium. Conocimiento de Robot Framework y Katalon. Manejo de Gradle y/o Maven. Experiencia en pruebas de rendimiento con K6, JMeter y Rational Performance Tester. Conocimiento de Azure (Deseable) ¡PRESENTATE y sé parte de esta historia!
